changes: date.weekday: 'roja' is not a weekday (Nep./Pers. roja 'day'); set to empty
p1 confidence lowered to medium: the form 'caṃdravīrasurya' has no genitive marker and 'surya' may be a family name, so the name split is uncertain
notes expanded: translation of the ownership formula; catalogue scribe not found in the colophon

notes: The era is not named, but saṃvat 1932 with 'sāla'/'roja' is Vikrama, which the catalogue also has (VS 1932). Mārga śukla 7 VS 1932 falls about Dec. 1875. The Newari ownership note 'thva suphu caṃdravīrasurya jula, sunānaṃ lobha yāya madū' means 'this book has become Candravīrasūrya's; nobody may covet it.' The form 'caṃdravīrasurya' has no genitive ending. 'Surya' may be a surname (Candravīra Sūrya), so the stem form is uncertain. The catalogue gives the scribe as 'Suddhiratna' (probably Śuddharatna), but that name does not appear in the quoted colophon; it may come from elsewhere in the MS, so it is not entered here. The catalogue puts 'SAM (VS) 1932' in the place-of-copying field; this is a date, not a place.
